name: Terror Run
summary: In Terror Run, predators stalk the open shelf beneath Un'Goro Crater's southwestern rim. The land lies west of the Slithering Scar, with devilsaurs and diemetradons below and pterrordax overhead.

sections.title: A Hunt in the Open
sections.body:
Beneath Un'Goro Crater's mountainous rim, Terror Run spreads across the southwestern shelf. Pterrordax wheel overhead as diemetradons, stegodons, and apex devilsaurs roam the low brush. The Slithering Scar's strange mounds lie close by.

Along Terror Run's eastern edge, the ruins of a camp mark where Williden Marshal's expedition was caught unprepared. The crater's primeval predators closed in before they could escape.

sections.title: Red Crystals and Ancient Predators
sections.body:
Naturalists and adventurers come to Terror Run for Red Power Crystals, which rise from its fertile soil. Their crimson formations hum with primeval energy, like the blue, green, and yellow crystals found elsewhere in the basin.

Yet gathering them means facing the plains' strongest hunters. Apex devilsaurs nest in the deep south and brook no trespassers.

faq.q: Why is this area called Terror Run?
faq.answer: Terror Run takes its name from the many apex predators roaming its open corridor. Massive devilsaurs and territorial diemetradons prowl the flats while pterrordax watch from above. Anyone crossing on foot may have to sprint for their life.

faq.q: What can be found here besides dangerous beasts?
faq.answer: Red Power Crystals rise from the earth only in Terror Run. On the eastern edge, you can also find an abandoned research camp from Williden Marshal's expedition, left behind during its dangerous survey of the crater.

faq.q: What is the abandoned camp on the eastern edge?
faq.answer: The abandoned campsite belonged to members of Williden Marshal's expedition. Scientists and explorers left their research equipment and fled when local wildlife overwhelmed their position.

faq.q: Where does Terror Run lie in relation to other landmarks?
faq.answer: Terror Run spans southwestern Un'Goro Crater, directly west of the silithid-infested hives of the Slithering Scar and south of the central volcano, Fire Plume Ridge.

angles.text: As a hunter, you find some of Kalimdor's fiercest beasts across Terror Run's vast plains, from swift raptors and savage pterrordax to towering devilsaurs.
